## Recent entries (2026) — new API/resource/entity additions [ALL REPORTED in prior scan]

### June 19, 2026
- Tenants: added `migrate` method to crossTenantMigrationJob resource; validate is now entity-bound action.
- Security: new `policyTipAction` resource; added `policyTip` member to dlpAction enum.
- Tasks & Plans: new resources plannerTaskData, plannerTaskDetailsData, plannerHistoryItem, taskHistoryItem; historyEntityType/historyEventType enums.
- Teamwork & Communications: new cloudVideoInteropInfo resource; isRegistrationRequired, meetingType/onlineMeetingType additions.

### June 17-18, 2026
- Identity & Access: access package suggestions resources; filterByCurrentUser method.
- Applications: new redirectUri configuration resources.
- Security: new account/file action resources; entity-mapping detection resources.

### June 16 & earlier June 2026
- Mail: distributionList / distributionListMember resources. Files container permissions; identity governance workflow extensions; FIDO2 improvements; app risk assessment resources; backup/restore session enhancements.

Updated: 2026-07-07 — No net-new entries since prior scan (2026-07-06). RSS still tops at June 19, 2026;
all entries generic API churn, none AI/agent/Copilot-specific. No reportable addition.
